reviewNotes: Removed hero; added separately layered animated hearth flame and embers plus ornate wooden and iron ingot rack.
Fixed hidden forge background and stray question-card hero in tall practice view; checked practice and landscape gameplay.
User requested selected hero with a hammer strike, smaller scenery and correctly aligned flame in the tall view, and a more distinct rack. Visual elements remain separately positioned.

Added gold, silver and bronze metallic finishes to independently interactive rack ingots; colours follow shuffled rack positions. Verified correct selection and strike in desktop, short desktop and phone landscape browser views; website build passed. Awaiting review.
Anchored hero's renderer foot baseline to the anvil's shared floor line. Checked desktop, short desktop and phone landscape during correct strikes, and incorrect strikes with reduced motion.

Lowered the hero further onto the visible paving in compact landscape and moved the progress markers clear of the feet. Checked correct strikes at desktop, short desktop and phone landscape; website build passed. Awaiting review.

Chromium touch emulation showed 30 tiles and successful selection at 812 × 375 and 1024 × 768; level 5 rendered neutral tiles. Phone tiles measured 37 × 37 CSS pixels and need mobile layout review. WebKit and native iOS testing remain outstanding.
